search_window.basis: Last available verified Food Line heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger completed at 05:49:10.867 PST. Reported event or official notice time must establish novelty inside this window; indexing and crawl timestamps do not suffice.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary high-value Food Line recall; production nationwide collector remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss/closure/fire/disaster of only, sole, last or full-service community grocery
Cancellation or suspension of emergency food distributions because of storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry/food-bank closure or major access reduction
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "November 1 2026" food distribution canceled storm outage emergency
"November 1 2026" food pantry distribution cancelled flood fire
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted web searches returned usable results. No verified new qualifying incident or official interruption within the hourly observation window was identified. Search results included dated older incidents, calendar listings, preannounced benefit restrictions, and reposted coverage of previously tracked closures.
